name: Adenocarcinoma
description: A cancer that forms in mucus-secreting glands and is common in the colon, lungs, pancreas, and breast.

name: Sarcoma
description: A rare cancer of connective tissues such as bone, cartilage, fat, muscle, or blood vessels.

name: Leukemia
description: A cancer of blood-forming tissues that leads to the overproduction of abnormal white blood cells.

name: Glioma
description: A tumor that starts in the glial cells of the brain or spine. Glioblastoma is the most aggressive form.

name: Melanoma
description: An aggressive skin cancer that originates in pigment-producing cells called melanocytes.

name: Squamous Cell Carcinoma
description: A cancer that arises in flat squamous cells, commonly found in the head, neck, and lungs.

name: Ductal Carcinoma
description: The most common type of breast cancer, originating in the milk ducts of the breast tissue.

name: Mesothelioma
description: A rare and aggressive cancer linked to asbestos exposure, affecting the lining of the lungs.

name: Neuroblastoma
description: A cancer that arises in immature nerve cells and most commonly affects infants and children.

name: Thymoma
description: A tumor originating in the thymus gland, often associated with autoimmune diseases like myasthenia gravis.

name: Breast Cancer
description: A broad category of cancers arising from breast tissue, including ductal and lobular carcinomas.

name: Lung Adenocarcinoma
description: A common subtype of lung cancer originating in glandular cells of the lung tissue.

name: Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma
description: A form of lung cancer that starts in the squamous cells lining the airways.

name: Colon Adenocarcinoma
description: A common colon cancer arising from glandular cells lining the colon.

name: Rectal Adenocarcinoma
description: Cancer originating from glandular cells in the rectum, similar to colon adenocarcinoma.

name: Prostate Cancer
description: A common cancer affecting the prostate gland in males.

name: Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma
description: The most common type of primary liver cancer originating from hepatocytes.

name: Stomach Adenocarcinoma
description: A cancer that originates in the glandular cells of the stomach lining.

name: Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma
description: A highly aggressive cancer that begins in the pancreatic ducts.

name: Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma
description: A cancer originating in the urothelial cells lining the bladder.

name: Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma
description: The most common type of kidney cancer, arising from the lining of kidney tubules.

name: Lymphoma (DLBCL)
description: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, an aggressive cancer of the lymphatic system.

name: Ovarian Serous Cystadenocarcinoma
description: The most common type of ovarian cancer, originating from the serous epithelium.

name: Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma
description: A cancer arising from the squamous cells of the cervix.

name: Esophageal Carcinoma
description: Cancer that forms in the tissues lining the esophagus.

name: Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
description: A cancer affecting the squamous cells in the head and neck region.

name: Thyroid Carcinoma
description: A cancer that develops in the thyroid gland's follicular cells.
